fusions.name: Hauled Brake Spin
fusions.desc: You haul the brake and spin your ride. It deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Snatched Mid-Stride
fusions.desc: Reaches out as you pass and snatches the first enemy in its path. It deals 24 damage and can only be used on a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Pulled Aboard
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Holding On
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
